title: The Dark Truth of Samurai Honor
hook: Testing a new katana sword on random commoners was legal.

scenes.text: Modern pop culture portrays samurai as chivalrous, poetic warriors guided by a strict pacifist moral code.
scenes.imagePrompt: Peaceful Japanese Zen rock garden with raked white gravel and mossy stones under cherry blossom petals. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Modern pop culture portrays samurai as chivalrous, poetic warriors guided by a strict pacifist moral code.

scenes.text: In reality, during the Sengoku Civil War era, samurai were pragmatic, ruthless warlords whose loyalty was bought with land and gold.
scenes.imagePrompt: Stone courtyard of a Sengoku period Japanese fortress castle with wooden watchtowers and battle banners in twilight. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: In reality, during the Sengoku Civil War era, samurai were pragmatic, ruthless warlords whose loyalty was bought with land and gold.

scenes.text: They practiced 'tsujigiri' or 'crossroads cutting': testing the sharpness of a newly forged katana on unsuspecting travelers at dark crossroads.
scenes.imagePrompt: Dark misty dirt crossroads outside a Japanese village at night with a stone roadside Jizo statue in moonlight. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: They practiced 'tsujigiri' or 'crossroads cutting': testing the sharpness of a newly forged katana on unsuspecting travelers at dark crossroads.

scenes.text: Furthermore, under the 'kiri-sute gomen' law, a samurai had the legal right to execute any peasant on the spot for perceived disrespect.
scenes.imagePrompt: Traditional Japanese village street with thatched roofs, wooden irrigation channels, and sliding rice-paper shoji doors. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Furthermore, under the 'kiri-sute gomen' law, a samurai had the legal right to execute any peasant on the spot for perceived disrespect.

scenes.text: The romantic 'Bushido' honor code was actually codified centuries later during peacetime Edo, long after large-scale sword battles had ceased.
